entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-03
entry.content:
Azure.Provisioning.SelfHelp_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-02)

Features Added

  • Initial release of Azure.Provisioning.SelfHelp.

Azure.Provisioning.ServiceGroups_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-02)

Features Added

  • Initial beta release of Azure.Provisioning.ServiceGroups.

Azure.ResourceManager.NetApp_1.20.0-beta.1

1.20.0-beta.1 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-08-15-preview.
  • Added ExternalClusterResource and ExternalSvmResource, together with their collections and models, for external NetApp ONTAP clusters and storage virtual machines.
  • Added ClusterPeerResource and SvmPeerResource, together with their collections and models, for cluster and storage virtual machine peering.
  • Added ExternalCacheResource and ExternalCacheConnectionResource, together with their collections and models, for external caches and cache connections between external and Azure NetApp Files volumes.
  • Added GeoNamespaceOriginVolume to NetAppVolumeData, NetAppVolumePatch, and NetAppVolumeGroupVolume, with the OriginVolume enum for geographic namespace origin settings.
  • Added asynchronous directory deletion settings through AsyncDirectoryDelete and AsyncDirectoryDeleteStatus on volume and volume-group models.
  • Added SMB opportunistic locking settings through SmbOplocks on volume, volume-group, and NetAppSmbSettings models.
  • Added UserAssignedIdentity to CertificateKeyVaultDetails and CredentialsKeyVaultDetails for user-assigned managed identity access to Key Vault-backed bucket certificates and credentials.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed account and account-patch Entra ID configuration property forwarding and JSON serialization, including nested Key Vault settings.

Azure.Provisioning.Relationships_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-02)

Features Added

  • Initial release of Azure.Provisioning.Relationships.

Azure.ResourceManager.Compute_1.19.0

1.19.0 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Added FlexPreferredVmSize to VirtualMachineData and VirtualMachinePatch to support FlexProfile preferred VM sizes.
  • Added PrivateIPAddressPrefixLength to VirtualMachineNetworkInterfaceIPConfiguration, VirtualMachineScaleSetIPConfiguration and VirtualMachineScaleSetUpdateIPConfiguration.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed CapacityReservationGroupResource delete operations to poll the long-running operation until completion.

Azure.Provisioning.Compute_1.0.0-beta.3

1.0.0-beta.3 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the Compute API version to 2026-04-01 and the ComputeGallery API version to 2026-03-03, aligning with Azure.ResourceManager.Compute.
  • Added VirtualMachineDiagnosticRunCommand and VirtualMachineScaleSetVMDiagnosticRunCommand resources.
  • Added VirtualMachine.FlexPreferredVmSize for configuring FlexProfile preferred VM sizes.
  • Added PrivateIPAddressPrefixLength to VirtualMachineNetworkInterfaceIPConfiguration and VirtualMachineScaleSetIPConfiguration.
  • Added support for gallery image metadata and data disk security profiles, capacity reservation state and utilization details, and secrets provisioning settings.

Breaking Changes

  • Replaced VirtualMachine.CapacityReservationGroupId and VirtualMachineScaleSetVmProfile.CapacityReservationGroupId with CapacityReservation.CapacityReservationGroupId.
  • Replaced VirtualMachineScaleSetVmProfile.HardwareVmSizeProperties with HardwareProfile.VmSizeProperties.
  • Replaced GalleryImageVersion.SecurityUefiSettings with SecurityProfile.UefiSettings.
  • Replaced GalleryResource.IsSoftDeleteEnabled with SoftDeletePolicy.IsSoftDeleteEnabled.

Azure.ResourceManager.DataProtectionBackup_1.10.0-beta.1

1.10.0-beta.1 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the API version to 2026-07-01.
  • Added vault and recovery point immutability configuration support.
  • Added PostgreSQL Flexible Server backup solution settings.

Azure.ResourceManager.Relationships_1.0.0

1.0.0 (2026-10-19)

This is the first stable release of the Relationships management client library.

Features Added

  • Updated the service API version to 2026-08-01.
  • Added APIs for listing Contains relationships at resource group and subscription scopes.
  • Added resource and collection APIs for managing DependencyOf relationships scoped to a service group.
  • Added pageable enumeration for DependencyOf and service group member relationship collections.

Breaking Changes

  • Corrected the source and target semantics of ServiceGroupMemberRelationshipProperties. The constructor now accepts sourceId, SourceId is settable, TargetId is read-only, and SourceTenant replaces TargetTenant.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed relationship collection paging to handle relative continuation tokens and propagate cancellation tokens during async enumeration.
  • Fixed Contains relationship operations to honor configured API version overrides.

Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.SignalRService_2.3.0

2.3.0 (2026-11-02)

Other Changes

  • Updated MessagePack to 2.5.307 and Microsoft.Azure.SignalR.Serverless.Protocols to 1.11.1 to address GHSA-qhrr-8q5h-9q3h, including the protocol assembly's embedded MessagePack reader.
